name: strata-terrain-stream
subject: PRD-790: run with ?tnTerrainValidate=1&propCollision=off (streaming is the default). The camera turns 156 degrees, then the player sprints 2 km in one straight line north-north-west (heading 336 degrees from +z toward +x, -0.41 x, +0.91 z): 80 m to the square's west edge, then over the streamed ground, where no slope on that line is over 40 degrees for 2.7 km. Every other line from the spawn meets a slope over 45 degrees before 2 km. Prop collision is off because this is a straight line through a forest, not a spawn fault: a trunk stands just past the 4 m spawn clearing on it (the run stops after 4.46 m with it on, 2026-11-14); collide.playtest.json proves the trunks

resources.allowTrivial: Sprint is 9 m/s for 250 s on one heading; 2 km only if no wall, slope or gap stops the run.
The farthest the player stood from the spawn in a straight line: 2 km of path that turned or circled reads less.
2 km on heading 336 ends 1.4 km north of the square's edge; without streamed ground the walls stop the run 200 m past it.
The run ends standing on a streamed tile's collider, not falling through a missing one.
Far past the square every tile around the player is streamed.
The largest height gap between neighbouring tile edges.
Measured only under ?tnTerrainValidate=1; -1 otherwise, so an unmeasured run fails.

The height step at a tile vertex where the tiles meet the collar (the edge of the square they draw), as core measures a tile-to-tile seam: the outermost tile slides onto the collar's drawn height. It was 2.03 m on this route before that band.
Measured only under ?tnTerrainValidate=1; -1 otherwise, so an unmeasured run fails.
Between two tile vertices a fold of the collar's coarser triangles can cross the 2 m tile edge; 0.16-0.44 m on this route, under a pixel at the 288 m edge at 720p. Reported, not hidden.
Measured only under ?tnTerrainValidate=1; -1 otherwise, so an unmeasured run fails.

components.allowTrivial: A pipeline counter must measure the run, or a zero below is silence, not a measurement.

Every pipeline the far run needs is built behind the curtain: the tiles and the lake draw unculled there, and core draws the shadow reset quad with the first whole shadow map. Before, a turn 1.8 km out built the reset quad and the lake mirror's first draws of the terrain and ridges; before that, the lake's two-pass draw rebuilt its pipeline 58 times there.
